A Strange Disease

一种奇怪的病 · 165 词 · 3 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1When construction of the fireworks factory reached the painting stage, a pump was installed. Then, all the painters nearby fell seriously ill with a disease whose main symptoms resembled severe burns.

2An experienced physician was asked to attend to the patients and handle the case. He was enthusiastic, but he did not expect the case to be such a challenge. After making some initial enquiries, he announced that contaminated paint was to blame. But without firm evidence, people suspected he was wrong and rejected his explanation, saying the theory he put forward made no sense. He set himself higher standards and devoted himself to the investigation. Apart from making enquiries, he made detailed charts and analysed the data cautiously. Finally, he drew a scientific conclusion, linking the disease to the radium in the pump. Radium is radioactive, and exposure to its radiation had made the workers sick.

3Specialists removed the source of radiation. After the exposure ended, the patients received medical care and eventually recovered.

高考英语3500词 · 21中文译文

一种奇怪的病

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1烟花厂建到油漆施工阶段时，装进了一台水泵。随后，附近的油漆工全都染上了一种重病，症状和严重烧伤很像。

2一位经验丰富的医生受命照料患者，并调查这起事件。他很热心，却没想到这会是个难题。初步询问之后，他宣布问题出在受污染的油漆上。由于没有确凿的证据，人们怀疑并否定了他的判断，说他的说法讲不通。他对自己提出更高的要求，一心扑在调查上。除了继续走访，他还绘制了详细的图表，谨慎地分析数据。最后，他得出了一个科学结论，把这场病和水泵里的镭联系起来。镭有放射性，工人正是因为受到它的辐射而生病的。

3专业人员移除了辐射源。停止接触辐射后，患者接受了治疗，最终康复。
